 Advertisement Updated: 7:54 PM EDT Oct 26, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Rachael Perry Reporter Briny Breezes residents call current flooding the worst they’ve seen
 Updated: 7:54 PM EDT Oct 26, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Rachael Perry Reporter BRINY BREEZES, Fla. — Residents in Briny Breezes say the flooding caused by the current round of king tides is the worst they have experienced. 
 Coastal flood warning issued for Palm Beach County as king tides raise flooding risk Briny Breezes is a coastal community located on the barrier island along State Road A1A between Boynton Beach and Delray Beach. 
 Advertisement Officials have advised people to avoid driving through flooded areas, noting, “This round of king tides is expected to continue through the end of October.”
 Significant flooding reported in Palm City A coastal flood warning is in effect for Palm Beach County as king tides and strong winds raise the risk of flooding near high tide.
